market_view: Pre-market 6:40 ET Wednesday, the last full session before Thanksgiving: the AI giveback deepens. SPY ~705.8 (-1.8%), QQQ ~620.3 (-2.8%), IWM 264.1; NVDA ~147.6 (-5.0%) after -5.9% Tuesday, SMH -4.5%, KLAC 126.5 (-5.3%), CRWV 39.7 (-6.8%); Dell -7.4% and Workday -9.7% after their reports. VIX 29.6, 10-year 4.90%, WTI US$81.45, gold US$3,550, BTC US$58,450 with Fear & Greed 13. 8:30 ET brings GDP, PCE, jobless claims and durable goods. Monday's gap is now mostly gone; the desk protects capital into the holiday.

shared_notes: Day before Thanksgiving: Thursday closed, Friday 1:00 PM ET close. Thin volume after lunch.
8:30 data first; no new trades before 10:00 except Dax's squeeze rules.
Option orders go live at 9:45 ET; Vega and Theo meet at 9:31 first.

day.view: Dax: Tuesday was a good grind: +C$60 net over EMBC, BDRX and APUS, and I'm carrying 5 AHT-PF overnight, so the first job is managing that at the open. Today has 8:30 data and a -2.8% QQQ gap, so I wait for 10:00, three trades max, and the 1R half banked at once with VIX near 30.

playbook.then: run the squeeze list, three trades max
sell half and move the stop to breakeven at once

plan_c.note: Down 4% on the day: stand aside

day.failsafe: Down 3% on the day or VIX over 32: stand aside.
lessons_applied: VIX near 30: take the 1R half and go to breakeven immediately.
Squeeze ORB only; plain ORB+VWAP skipped.

swing.view: Sam: COIN hit its stop Tuesday (-C$53), and the autopilot bought one KLAC at C$193.75 that I didn't plan: it's -5% pre-market with chips selling. CRWV 39.7 pre, RKT 14.31. SPY 705.8 is far under its 20-day (~745), so my lesson says no new play, and the KLAC stop at US$115 decides, not me.

playbook.if: SPY closes back above its 20-day average
playbook.then: the scan gets a look next week
the stop sells it; no re-buy this week

plan_b.note: KLAC stopped: cash waits for next week's scan

plan_c.note: Fear is up: no new buys

swing.failsafe: VIX over 26 or a 5% day loss: no new buys, stops stay.
lessons_applied: No new play in a falling market (S&P under its 20-day).
A dip buy outside the scan needs a planned sale: none today.

long.view: Lena: The week's buy is done (PBA). KLAC is my biggest drop, at US$126.5 pre against my US$113.50 and US$121 stops, but those were set about 18% under on purpose. AAPL 350.5, RY, BNS, SHEL and AES all hold above their stops. No sales on paper drawdown, no buys until Monday.

playbook.then: nothing changes: no buys this week anyway

plan_b.note: Week's buy done (PBA): no new orders

plan_c.note: Fear spike: no buys this week

long.failsafe: VIX over 28: no buys this week.
lessons_applied: Stops about 18% under the buy, checked weekly, not tightened on one day's news.
Paper drawdown with every stop intact: no sales.

futures.view: Fox: Gold is US$3,550, sliding toward the 20-day low, and that's the short working. Crude US$81.45 is above its low, so the crude short is under pressure. Trailing stops decide, no adds, no third position. If PCE is hot and the dollar jumps, gold's slide helps me.

playbook.then: the crude stop is close; no re-short

plan_b.note: Gold short stopped: no revenge trade

plan_c.note: Down 4%: no new futures; stops stay

futures.failsafe: Down 4% on the day: no new futures; stops stay.
lessons_applied: After a big open win: the trailing stop protects it, no adds.
After a big win, risk small: no third position.

options_aggr.view: Vega: The U put was cut at -C$205, and my rule says no U option for 3 days. QQQ is 620 pre, so a call needs a real reversal: above 640 (Tuesday's close area) after 9:45. No puts into a -2.8% gap either: chasing the drop is the same mistake as chasing the rip. One trade max.

plan_b.note: QQQ reclaims 640 (Tuesday's close area): the one trade today

orders.why: QQQ reclaiming 640 after the pre-holiday gap down: 2 calls about 3% out; -50% stop, +100% target

plan_c.note: No extension by 2:00: no option today

options_aggr.failsafe: Down 12% on the day or VIX over 30: no new options.
lessons_applied: Triggers wait for a real reclaim, not a gap.
After an option stop, no new option on that underlying for 3 days (U).
Two contracts so a risk-off cut doesn't round to zero.

options_safe.view: Theo: RKT 14.31 pre, rising away from my 12.50 strike with 16 days left. One put at a time: no new put, the cash stays parked.

playbook.then: hold, assignment at a price I chose is acceptable
the put decays faster, keep holding

playbook.if: No put across an earnings date, nothing under its 200-day

plan_b.note: No second put: the cash stays parked

options_safe.failsafe: VIX over 27: keep the cash, no new puts.
lessons_applied: One put at a time: RKT uses most of the buying power, so no new put.

crypto.view: Kai: BTC US$58,450 and Fear & Greed 13. The 7-day gap runs to Nov 30, so no buys. Stops one step wider after the review; ETH 1,636 is still above its 1,350 level.

playbook.if: BTC reclaims US$65,000 and holds a day
playbook.then: still no buy, a bounce isn't a signal

playbook.if: Fear & Greed rises above 25 with BTC over US$65,000

plan_b.note: A bounce is not a buy signal: hold and keep the cash

plan_c.note: Deeper flush: still no buys; stops handle exits

crypto.failsafe: Down 8% on the day: no buys; stops stay.
lessons_applied: The 7-day gap is a ceiling, not a target: one add today, no more.
Wider stops (stop_width 7) after five stops in two days.
